title: Shake Shack Teams Up with Mama’s TOO! for a Limited-Time Collab in NY!
body_markdown:
We’re joining forces with legendary NYC pizzeria Mama’s TOO! to drop a limited-time Sunday Sauce Menu, putting an Italian American and Shack spin on some classics and taking their celebrated flavors beyond Manhattan for the first time.


Available in select Shake Shack locations for two weekends only, this is a drop you won’t want to miss.


## What is on the Shake Shack and Mama’s TOO! Collab menu?


#### **The Sunday Sauce Menu**


### **Sunday Sauce Meatball Parm Hero**


Shake Shack meatballs, Mama’s TOO! Sunday Sauce, stracciatella, grated Parmigiano Reggiano, and fresh basil on a baked semolina hero.


### **Tiramisu Sundae**


House-made tiramisu layered with vanilla frozen custard and espresso fudge sauce, topped with whipped cream, a maraschino cherry, and a mini ice cream cone.


## **When is the Shake Shack and Mama’s Too! Menu available?**


Our collab with Mama’s TOO! Will be available for 2 weekends only, 11/5/2026-11/8/2026 and 11/12/2026-11/15/2026 in select NYC Shacks, while supplies last!


## Where is the Shake Shack and Mama’s TOO! Collaboration available?


*The collab menu is Available in-Shack only while supplies last at the following locations on select dates*


**Thursday, Nov. 5 – Sunday, Nov. 8**


West Village Shack: 225 Varick St., NYC


**Thursday, Nov. 12 – Sunday, Nov. 15**


Williamsburg Shack: 160 Berry St., Brooklyn


Forest Hills Shack: 71-24 Austin St., Forest Hills


New Hyde Park Shack: 1570 Union Tpke., New Hyde Park
